title: Injunction.
bodyText: The department of transportation may apply to the circuit court in the county in which the junkyards may be located for an injunction to abate the nuisance of a nonconforming junkyard.
bodyHtml: §264-88  Injunction.  The department of transportation may apply to the circuit court in the county in which the junkyards may be located for an injunction to abate the nuisance of a nonconforming junkyard. [L 1966, c 46, pt of §2; HRS §264-88]
